author: reek
body: Drives the REAL occurrence analyser (IR/Occurrence.codex, via the `occ-report` pass) over real lowered IR. Each function below is one of the six occurrence shapes the analyser must classify correctly. There is no reimplementation here: the shapes are ordinary Codex functions, the compiler lowers them to IRExpr, and `-Passes occ-report` runs `occ-analyse-def` over each and prints one `OCC <def>: name=Class` line per definition to the compile log. The pinned answers live in the sidecar `occurrence-check.occ-expected`, read off the real analyser and hand-checked against the source -- including that lowering may add or reshape binders, which the sidecar records as it truly is.

author: reek
body: occ-dead and occ-once differ ONLY in whether the binding is used, and classify Dead vs Once -- the proof the analyser is not a constant function.
